title: Large Army installation Attachment J-0302 facility list workbook: 420 in-scope facilities in six zones (UEPH, COF, BN/BDE HQ, TEMF, DFAC, chapels, PFCs, CDCs, clinics, warehouses, range latrines/towers, gatehouses) plus a Grounds sheet of improved / semi-improved / unimproved acres by cantonment zone and training area (scale test)

sources.note: Army Facilities Pricing Guide (PAX 3.2.2, 2017): CATCODE 14185 COMPANY OPERATIONS FACILITY (COF), 21410 tactical equipment maintenance facilities (TEMF) in small/medium/large sizes, 72210 dining facility entries, 72111 among the enlisted housing codes. Used for those CATCODE assignments only.

USACE unit costs for Army facilities: 14183 BATTALION HQS BLDG W/ CLASSROOMS, 14182 brigade headquarters building, 74042 indoor swimming pool as a code separate from the fitness center. Used for those CATCODE assignments.
FY05 facility unit cost table: 21410 VEHICLE MAINT SHOP - TRACK; 72111 unaccompanied personnel housing.
USACE Army facilities unit-cost table: 14114 CIDC field operations building; five-digit CATCD per DA Pam 415-28.
AR 415-28 Real Property Category Codes: the five-digit CATCODE system used in the CATCODE column.
Fort Cavazos Installation Custodial Service sources sought (PANMCC-25-P-0000015172): one installation custodial requirement with a separate PWS. Scale anchor only.
Summary of the same notice: roughly 500 to 600 government facilities. Basis for testing at 400+ buildings.

Fort Benning grounds maintenance sources sought: about 184,000 acres of improved, semi-improved and unimproved grounds, excluding the golf course, cemetery, airfield and some MWR areas. Basis for the three-category acreage layout and the NOT IN SCOPE golf course row.
Improved grounds (intensive maintenance) and semi-improved grounds (mowed occasionally) definitions, paraphrased on the Notes sheet.

provenance.notes: Generated by gen.mjs (seeded mulberry32 PRNG, seed 4202027). The installation (Fort Brannock), solicitation number, every building number, name, area, floor count, fixture count, frequency and acreage are invented. CATCODEs 14114, 14182, 14183, 14185, 21410, 72111, 72210 and 74042 follow the USACE cost tables cited. All other CATCODE assignments (61050, 73017, 74028, 74046, 55010, 54010, 44220, 44224, 44260, 21110, 21910, 17120, 17150, 73010, 73046, 73070, 73075, 74010, 74021, 74044, 74047, 74055, 12410, 14112, 14113, 14171, 17890-17892) are plausible but not verified against DA Pam 415-28. No public Army facility-list exhibit was downloadable, so the column layout follows the other fixtures and common Technical Exhibit practice, not a specific document. The workbook prints CATCODEs, not app categories: truth asserts a category only where the CATCODE family maps to exactly one app category, and none for building types an estimator could file two ways (README, Category rule). Each sheet carries a colWidths hint that scripts/render-fixtures.mjs does not apply yet.

traps: Scale: 428 listed facility rows, 420 in scope, 12,371,502 gross SF in total. Gross SF runs from 120 (ACP 1 MAIN GATE OVERWATCH BOOTH and RANGE 03 KD LATRINE) to 250,000 (INSTALLATION GENERAL PURPOSE WAREHOUSE (DOL)). Readers and the 3D campus must handle 400+ buildings without truncation, paging limits or dropping rows.

Names repeat among the in-scope rows: 66 x "COMPANY OPERATIONS FACILITY (COF)", 34 x "UEPH BARRACKS", 23 x "ORGANIZATIONAL STORAGE BLDG", 22 x "TACTICAL EQUIPMENT MAINT FACILITY (TEMF)", 22 x "GENERAL PURPOSE WAREHOUSE". (Rows listed including NOT IN SCOPE: 35 UEPH BARRACKS, 23 GENERAL PURPOSE WAREHOUSE.) 262 in-scope rows share a name with at least one other in-scope row. Only the building number tells them apart, so de-duplicating by name collapses hundreds of buildings.

Two-row merged header: "AREA (SQUARE FEET)" is merged over GROSS and CLEANABLE. ITEM (1..N) is a row counter, not a building number. CATCODE is a 5-digit number cell (e.g. 72111) and must not be read as square feet. BLDG NO. is a number cell for plain 5-digit numbers and a text cell for suffixed or T-prefixed numbers.

Zone section rows ("ZONE 2 - NORTH TROOP AREA", merged across) are headers, not facilities. Six "ZONE n SUBTOTAL - n FACILITIES IN SCOPE" rows and a "GRAND TOTAL - 420 FACILITIES IN SCOPE" row (12,371,502 SF) are not facilities.

8 rows are listed with SF but marked NOT IN SCOPE in Remarks (frequency N/A) and are excluded from truth and from the printed subtotals: 10809 ADMIN GEN PURPOSE (WWII WOOD) (VACANT - PENDING DISPOSAL - NOT IN SCOPE); 10814 SHOPPETTE (AAFES) (AAFES MAINTAINED - NOT IN SCOPE); 10816 BOWLING CENTER (NAF FACILITY - MWR CUSTODIAL - NOT IN SCOPE); 21926 UEPH BARRACKS (ROLLING PIN) (DEMOLISHED FY26 - NOT IN SCOPE); 31832 UEPH BARRACKS (UNDER RENOVATION THRU FY28 - NOT IN SCOPE); 40141 GENERAL PURPOSE WAREHOUSE (DEMOLISHED FY25 - NOT IN SCOPE); 50061 AIRCRAFT MAINTENANCE HANGAR (TRANSFERRED TO ARNG AASF - NOT IN SCOPE); 93101 RANGE 31 ZERO LATRINE (RANGE CLOSED - NOT IN SCOPE).

Building numbers with a letter suffix (TEMF storage annexes such as 20146A next to TEMF 20146) are separate facilities from the TEMF with the same digits. Relocatable buildings use T-prefixed numbers (T32001, T32003, T32004, T32007).

Cleanable SF is far below gross for UEPH barracks (common areas only, 18-26% of gross), TEMFs (12-20%), DOL maintenance shops (12-16%), hangars (15-25%) and warehouses (office and latrine areas only, 4-10%). It is a partial share for DPW shops (33-44%), fire and crash rescue stations (66-70%, apparatus bay and quarters excluded) and DFACs (63-69%, kitchen by the food service contractor). Do not default cleanable to gross.

Custodial frequency is a code (7X/WK, 5X/WK, 3X/WK, 2X/WK, 1X/WK, BI-WKLY, 1X/MO, QTRLY) defined on the Notes sheet: 7X/WK -> daily_7, 5X/WK -> daily_5, BI-WKLY -> biweekly, 1X/MO -> monthly, QTRLY -> quarterly. The Notes sheet "SERVICES PER YEAR" numbers (365, 250, ...) are not facilities.

Facility List note 5: Zone 6 range and training-area latrines, range control towers and range buildings are serviced at the listed frequency year-round (52 weeks). The Range Control schedule sets only the day of service, so the frequency codes are not discounted for range use.
RESTROOM FIXTURES is blank for buildings without restrooms (range control towers, range classrooms, storage buildings, the open overwatch booth); truth leaves restroomFixtures out for those.

Grounds sheet: two-row header with "ACRES BY GROUNDS CATEGORY" merged over IMPROVED / SEMI-IMPROVED / UNIMPROVED; a dash means zero. In-scope totals: improved 557.17 AC, semi-improved 3971.71 AC, unimproved 125436.75 AC. C-7 FAMILY HOUSING (RCI), C-8 GOLF COURSE (NAF) and IA-1 IMPACT AREA (DUDDED) are NOT IN SCOPE. The TOTAL ACRES column, the two SUBTOTAL rows and the GRAND TOTAL row must not be added again.

Unimproved training-area acreage (tens of thousands of acres, in scope for brush control and firebreaks per Grounds note 5) dominates total acres. A reader that drops it, or that also adds the 17,000+ acre impact area, is far off on unimproved acres.

Category is not printed; truth asserts it for 397 of 420 facilities, only where the CATCODE family maps to one app category (see README). Fire and crash rescue stations, the DES / MP station, post office, air traffic control tower, range operations and storage buildings, the visitor control center, the religious education center and the youth center carry no category because an estimator could file them two ways.
No dining workload (meals/day) is given; DFAC rows are custodial only, so truth asserts no dining profile.
